attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: weekly_workout_plan_generation
steps:
  - id: authenticate_user
    op: auth/verify_token
    params:
      source: request
      method: bearer_token
    output: user_session

  - id: read_fitness_profile
    op: database/read
    params:
      collection: user_profiles
      user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
      fields:
        - fitness_goals
        - fitness_level
        - available_equipment
        - age
        - weight
        - height
        - injuries
        - restrictions
    output: fitness_profile

  - id: read_workout_history
    op: database/query
    params:
      collection: workout_history
      user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
      sort_by: date
      sort_order: descending
      limit: 30
      fields:
        - date
        - exercises
        - sets
        - reps
        - weights
        - duration
        - perceived_difficulty
    output: recent_history

  - id: generate_weekly_plan
    op: ai/generate
    params:
      model: fitness-plan-generator
      prompt_template: weekly_workout_plan
      inputs:
        fitness_profile: "{{ fitness_profile }}"
        workout_history: "{{ recent_history }}"
      constraints:
        plan_duration_days: 7
        respect_equipment: true
        respect_injuries: true
        progressive_overload: true
    output: generated_plan

  - id: validate_plan_safety
    op: validation/check_workout_plan
    params:
      plan: "{{ generated_plan }}"
      user_profile: "{{ fitness_profile }}"
      recent_history: "{{ recent_history }}"
      rules:
        - max_volume_increase_percent: 10
        - required_rest_days_min: 1
        - no_exercises_conflicting_with_injuries: true
        - heart_rate_zones_appropriate_for_level: true
        - max_consecutive_training_days: 5
    output: validation_result

  - id: deactivate_previous_plan
    op: database/update
    params:
      collection: training_plans
      filter:
        user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
        status: active
      update:
        status: archived
        archived_at: "{{ now() }}"
    depends_on:
      - validate_plan_safety
    condition: "{{ validation_result.is_valid == true }}"

  - id: store_and_activate_plan
    op: database/write
    params:
      collection: training_plans
      document:
        user_id: "{{ user_session.user_id }}"
        plan: "{{ generated_plan }}"
        status: active
        created_at: "{{ now() }}"
        valid_from: "{{ next_monday() }}"
        valid_to: "{{ next_monday_plus_days(7) }}"
        validation_report: "{{ validation_result }}"
    depends_on:
      - deactivate_previous_plan
    output: saved_plan
